thread:
maria: Heads-up — after the kernel rollout to a100-uswest-pool1 I see peer-to-peer access blacklisted on several A100 hosts. Jobs started falling back to PCIe copies and latency spiked. Anyone else seeing this?

adeep: I spotted increased tail latency on gpu-infer queues ~02:45 UTC, correlates with the deploy. Can you paste nvidia-smi topo and dmesg?

maria: pasted initial samples below (one host):
```
$ nvidia-smi topo -m
        GPU0    GPU1    CPU
GPU0    X       PF      0
GPU1    PF      X       0

$ dmesg | tail -n 20
[  743.123456] NVRM: GPU 00000000:3B:00.0: BAR1 size changed from 0x20000000 to 0x10000000
[  743.123459] nvidia: P2P disabled due to BAR1 size / ACS mismatch
```

chris: oh no. BAR1 shrinkage + ACS enforcement after kernel bump is a known pattern with that driver/kernel combo. Which kernel & driver were rolled?

maria: kernel 5.15.0-72 -> 5.15.0-74 (auto canary across pool), nvidia-driver 525.85.05 (unchanged). infra-bot shows rollout log: KernelRolloutBot: rolled pool a100-uswest-pool1 -> 2026-03-16T02:47Z

infra-bot: KernelRolloutBot: kernel=5.15.0-74 -> applied to 12 hosts in a100-uswest-pool1. No manual flags.

julia: Quick reproducible check: run `cat /sys/bus/pci/devices/0000:3b:00.0/resource` and `lspci -vvv` to inspect ACS and BAR sizes. If ACS is now enforced we might see isolation and p2p negotiation falling back.

kevin: I'm seeing 8 nodes with reduced BAR1 to 256MB in telemetry, others intact. That explains the sudden drop in continuous batching throughput. Jobs spilled to CPU and we're burning more quota. Estimated extra cloud spend ~ $6k/day if not mitigated.

maria: Thanks. Two paths: 1) roll kernel back for the affected nodes, 2) try ACS override (pcie_acs_override) kernel param, 3) vendor escalation to validate driver/kernel interplay. Thoughts?

chris: We should avoid ACS override globally; it's risky security-wise. For immediate relief I'd vote rollback to 5.15.0-72 on affected hosts and gate further rollouts. We can keep a subset (canary) on 5.15.0-74 for deeper repro.

adeep: Agreed. I can orchestrate an emergency rollback on the 8 hosts if we have a maintenance window. How many inference pods will be impacted? @sre-oncall do we have spare capacity in other regions to spill?

sre-oncall: We can shift non-latency-critical queues to us-east with ~30% degraded throughput. Need ops approval for cross-region network egress. Also, recommend notifying customers on dedicated capacity SLAs.

maria: I'm going to snapshot workloads and schedule rollback. Plan: mark 8 nodes cordon+drain, rollback kernel package, verify nvidia-smi topo and BAR1 size, uncordon. If OK, stop further kernel rollout and open a vendor ticket.

julia: Add a pre/post check in the rollback playbook: `nvidia-smi -q | grep -A2 \"BAR1\"` and `grep -i acs /sys/kernel/debug/pci` (if debugfs mounted). Also collect `modinfo nvidia` and `dmesg | grep -i acs` for triage.

chris: I'll prepare the Ansible rollback play and a short alert runbook for oncall. Maria, please make a record with the node list and timestamps so we can correlate to job traces.

maria: Doing that now. Node list + timestamps saved to infra-runbooks/a100-peerlink-audit/rollback-1815142020.log (internal path). Rolling at 03:20 UTC — will update in thread.

infra-bot: ChangeControl: emergency kernel rollback requested by maria for 8 hosts in a100-uswest-pool1. ETA start 03:20 UTC. Approval: auto-approved by oncall.

kevin: After rollback we should run a small perf suite: 1) continuous batching 2) NVLink p2p bulk throughput 3) end-to-end latency for 95/99th. I can run those and post diffs.

maria: rollback started 03:21 UTC. first host back at 03:26 with p2p restored per nvidia-smi topo. continuing.

chris: once rollback completes let's freeze kernel rollouts in that pool and file a driver/kernel compatibility postmortem. We need gating: verify BAR1 invariants and ACS bits before any automatic kernel rollout.

julia: filing RFC: add a healthcheck to rollout pipeline that runs the BAR1 size probe + nvidia p2p check. If mismatch -> fail the rollout. I'll draft it.

maria: rollback finished 03:48 UTC. All 8 nodes show BAR1 restored and p2p reenabled. Latency normalized. Opening vendor ticket with the captured dmesg/modinfo and reproduction steps.

sre-oncall: Good job. Keep an eye on costs/spillover for the next 24h. We'll schedule a blameless postmortem and mitigation plan. :thumbsup:

maria: Thanks everyone — will follow up with the postmortem link and the rollout-gate RFC.
